title: All The Runes
description: ATR is a magic-focused modpack that makes your Minecraft better with stunning bosses and spells!
body:
![ATR](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f35e6c71290d156b1d275b660db23798b2daad08.png)

![modpack info](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a4fb722320423896d9d1245bab5e0a93b0db4d77.png)


Welcome to the ATR Modpack!
All The Runes is a modpack that focuses on the mods **Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks**, **Cataclysm** & **Create**!

You can cast beautiful spells and defeat unique bosses to be the strongest mage!


.

![main mods](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6c35a75f1a496152eabf79cde2825c5d66fe538f.png)
Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks
Addons for Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks
Create + Addons
Cataclysm
+ others

![multiplayer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a6ca82ddabb080d32471985cea680bbf28afd310.png)

This modpack is compatible in Singleplayer and Multiplayer!
Server Pack coming soon, but for now you can pretty much upload all the mods into your server, client-side mods will disable automatically.
